use: ORRERY section 5 "Codex plates": the art in the codex reader's circular aperture (src/ui/screens/codex.js)
generator: OpenAI built-in imagegen for entries; historical beat plates generated through Codex image generation.
license: Generated for SpaceFace by the project; no third-party source image supplied.
style: Contemporary dramatic space-opera art with several related treatments: atmospheric digital paintings, expressive concept-art scenes, graphic illustrations, and symbolic object studies. Deep indigo and charcoal anchor the set; cyan, amber, coral, violet, and pearl accents vary with faction and story. Each plate uses a readable square composition and a soft circular vignette with transparency outside. Avoid retro paperback/pulp-cover tropes, generic centered poster poses, and all-over text or interface.

beat0.subject: an impounded, battered mid-size cargo hauler sitting alone in a dark docking berth under a single hanging work lamp, one sealed cargo container strapped to its deck with a clipped paper manifest tag

beat1.subject: a cargo hauler towing a short train of shipping containers along a lit freight lane through a dim asteroid belt, one container freshly half-repainted

beat2.subject: a small armed hauler firing one tracer burst at a hostile fighter silhouetted against a burning asteroid, sparks and debris in the dark

beat3.subject: a larger freighter hull held in a shipyard cradle under scaffolds and bright welding sparks, a single sale lamp glowing over the berth

beat4.subject: three different warships holding station around one small clearing station, each ship lit by running lights of a different colour, one lit administrator window in the station

beat7.use: Story · B7 The Deep Reach, and the endgame choices offered there
beat7.subject: a lone ship approaching a violet swirling anomaly at the edge of charted space, a dark derelict station silhouetted against its glow

beat5.subject: a salvage crew in suits cutting into a derelict ship inside a debris ring, sealed data cores carried out under floodlights

beat6.subject: a first small automated mining outpost anchored to an asteroid, drones and a cargo tether, its first beacon light just switching on

note: Story beats retain their original plates. The entries map adds dedicated art for all 17 unique wrecks, six persistent cargo effects, the four previously unillustrated figures, dynamic Codex/World record surfaces, and five distinct endings. Wreck art is shared between World and Discoveries; named captains and provenance records use faction crests; remaining discovery plates keep their authored stills.

artDirection.visualUnity: Dramatic light, authored silhouettes, layered atmosphere, and circular reader framing connect the set.
artDirection.styleVariation: Vary rendering and palette by subject: wreck scenes, archival still lifes, anonymous character scenes, and symbolic endings.
artDirection.processing: 640x640 WebP; preserve source transparency or apply a soft circular alpha edge when the source is opaque.
